subject: Shiny Server Error Depends on Port Number

messages.author: 7b36a5521b8eb4d4
messages.subject: Shiny Server Error Depends on Port Number
parts:
I tried two ways of starting my Shiny application. I first pasted into the web browser the URL that I see when I use RStudio and use the Run External setting for the Run App button. Using http://127.0.0.1:7187/ has no problems.

However, when I use http://127.0.0.1:3838/survival/ instead of a plot, I see "Error: unable to start device PNG". Also, when I go to the Welcome page http://127.0.0.1:3838/ I see the same error where the plot should be, below the slider.

There are no error messages seen in /var/log/shiny-server.log What is happening ?
